name: @evertrust/horizon-mcp
description: MCP server for Evertrust Horizon certificate lifecycle management

scripts.build:binary: bun run build && bun build --compile dist/index.js --outfile dist/horizon-mcp --external playwright
scripts.build:binaries: bun run build && bun build --compile dist/index.js --outfile dist/horizon-mcp-linux-x64 --target=bun-linux-x64 --external playwright --external chromium-bidi --external electron && bun build --compile dist/index.js --outfile dist/horizon-mcp-linux-arm64 --target=bun-linux-arm64 --external playwright --external chromium-bidi --external electron && bun build --compile dist/index.js --outfile dist/horizon-mcp-darwin-x64 --target=bun-darwin-x64 --external playwright --external chromium-bidi --external electron && bun build --compile dist/index.js --outfile dist/horizon-mcp-darwin-arm64 --target=bun-darwin-arm64 --external playwright --external chromium-bidi --external electron && bun build --compile dist/index.js --outfile dist/horizon-mcp-windows-x64.exe --target=bun-windows-x64 --external playwright --external chromium-bidi --external electron
